title: One thing about me: I ~love~ immersive theatre, so I will absolutely ...
transcript: So you know that really cool immersive production of Phantom of the opera that has been rumored for a couple months now? Well, this just popped up. This is a website that just popped up. Masquerade NYC com and no one really seems to know what it is. But as you can see, there is a place to put your first name, last name, and email and it is basically a place to input your contact information to be the first to find out about this new production that seems to be phantom related. Now, as for if this is legit or not, it does seem to be real. As you can see, there is a copyright from the Really Useful Group, which is Andrew Lloyd Webber's production company, and it has a pretty fleshed out terms and conditions as well. It also says that the site is operated by the production and concession of P O T O L L C, which I did look up and is a real L L C. All of that does make me think that this is real and could be a hint towards this immersive production of Phantom coming. And the fact that it's called masquerade also makes me think that they're taking a cats the gelato ball approach where they'll rename it something like masquerade A Phantom of the opera experience. Since in order to take Phantom of the opera and make it a fully immersive experience, I think that there's A lot of changes to the source material that they're going to have to make, but either way, I am very excited to see how they do it.
classificationReason: Discussion of rumored immersive Phantom production and new website discovery - commentary about potential show announcement, not reviewing an existing production from the list
